title: Unlocked PC left unattended
symptom: A technician finds an unlocked PC with an open email in an empty office
user_description: I walked past an empty desk and the PC is unlocked with someone's email open on the screen. What should I do?

options.text: Leave it, it is not your PC
options.why: Anyone could read or send mail as that person. An unlocked PC is a security problem you can easily reduce.

options.text: Shut it down to teach the user a lesson
options.why: Unsaved work may be lost, and it is unkind. Locking the screen protects the data without causing damage.

options.text: Post a photo of it in the team chat as a joke
options.why: Spreads the exposed information and embarrasses the user instead of fixing the problem.

options.text: Lock the screen, tell the user or their manager, and remind them to lock when they leave
options.why: Locking the screen protects the data straight away and does no harm. Telling the user makes sure it does not keep happening.

hints: What is the quickest way to protect the screen without losing anything?
What could someone do with an unlocked mailbox?
How will the user learn from this?
real_world_tip: The Windows key plus L locks a PC instantly. Teach users the shortcut.
